newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on disappointing exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on disappointing exports.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a disappointing number for rice in USDA's weekly export sales report, traders said.
"Export sales were pretty shallow and that held the market in check," a trader said.
USDA early Thursday said U.S. net export sales of rice during the week ended Feb 6 totaled 20,600 tonnes, well below some trade expectations for roughly 40,000 tonnes.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 700 contracts, sharply below the 1,546 contracts traded during Wednesday's active session.
Rice closed unchanged to three cents lower, with March down 1-1/2 at $12.14 per cwt.
